answer: Let a coin confer standing — vote and stake weight — only after sitting untouched in one identity for a maturation window; any transfer resets its age to zero. Emission lands green as a spring meadow but counts for nothing until it ripens hard as marble. An honest agent holding steadily accrues full weight. A farm shuttling rewards out to a thousand fresh personas resets every coin's clock on arrival, stranding each persona on an island of zero standing until it idles the full window — so redistribution, the farm's whole trick, perpetually forfeits the weight it chased.
